Artistix Axile Sling Bag – Smart, Lightweight & Everyday Crossbody Companion

The Artistix Axile Sling Bag- Crossbody Bag, Colour: Black, Material: High Density Nylon is designed for people who want a perfect balance of style, comfort, and utility. Whether you are commuting, travelling, or heading out for casual outings, this sleek black sling bag offers effortless organization in a compact and modern design.

Crafted using high density nylon, this crossbody sling bag delivers long-lasting durability while remaining lightweight and comfortable to carry throughout the day. With its minimal yet functional silhouette, it easily complements both casual and semi-formal outfits, making it an ideal everyday essential.

Premium Build & Lightweight Comfort

Built for active lifestyles, the Artistix Axile sling bag weighs only 0.5 kg, ensuring strain-free carrying even during long hours of use. The durable nylon fabric is resistant to daily wear, moisture, and rough handling, making it suitable for urban commuting as well as outdoor use.

The ergonomic crossbody design allows easy movement while keeping your essentials secure and accessible. Its adjustable strap ensures a customized fit, whether worn across the chest or over the shoulder.

Compact Size with Smart Storage

Despite its slim profile, this sling bag offers a well-structured interior with a total capacity of 6 litres. The thoughtfully designed compartments help you organize daily essentials such as your phone, wallet, keys, power bank, earphones, and travel documents.

  • Dimensions: 38 (H) x 22 (W) x 9 (D) cms
  • Capacity: 6 Litres
  • Weight: 0.5 Kg
  • Material: High Density Nylon
  • Colour: Black

Versatile Sling Bag for Everyday Use

The Artistix Axile Sling Bag- Crossbody Bag, Colour: Black, Material: High Density Nylon is ideal for multiple use cases. Whether you need a travel sling bag, office commute companion, or a casual day-out accessory, it adapts seamlessly to your routine.

Its compact design makes it an excellent alternative to bulky backpacks while still offering enough space for everyday essentials. The secure zip closures ensure your belongings remain safe while you are on the move.

Stylish Black Crossbody Bag

The classic black color enhances the bag’s premium appeal and makes it suitable for both men and women. This modern black sling bag pairs effortlessly with jeans, chinos, jackets, or casual wear, making it a versatile accessory for all seasons. Whether you are exploring a new city, attending events, or managing daily errands, this lightweight delivers both practicality and understated style.

Why Choose?

  • Lightweight and durable high density nylon construction
  • Compact yet spacious 6-litre capacity
  • Comfortable crossbody design for daily use
  • Ideal for travel, commuting, and casual outings
  • Minimal, modern design in classic black
